name: Appartementpark Wilder Kaiser
beschreibung: Appartementpark Wilder Kaiser is situated on the edge of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, surrounded by alpine meadows and forests with splendid mountain views. The apartments feature a kitchenette and a private balcony or terrace. Facilities include a heated outdoor pool, a Finnish sauna, and a children's playground. The village centre with its shopping amenities is just a short walk away. In winter, guests enjoy convenient access to the Wilder Kaiser ski region, while in summer hiking trails begin right at the doorstep.
